rationale: Read as an approved path list, my plan is the only one whose file map contains the sources that fix the first half of the issue (src/prepareAgentBranch.ts and src/agentsProtocol.ts, where restoreProtocol silently returns without re-setting skip-worktree whenever no install root resolves, which is every vendored workspace per src/install.ts:372, plus the resume install-root path in src/runLoop.ts:458-465), whereas codex's map omits all four of those files while its plan asserts that restore is already correct and its strengthened tests always pass installRoot and so cannot see the defect, and cursor's map both keeps that same defect and adds a prepareAgentIssueBranches call before every writeAction that throws on any dirty clone and terminates the run loop via src/runLoop.ts:1290-1293 plus a created-file list that would overwrite three existing test suites; my plan's own verified defects are additive and one-line each — templates/product/AGENTS.protocol.md named in my prose but missing from the changed list, and test/install.test.ts:166 hardcoding 0.0.16 so the version bump leaves pnpm check:fast red — alongside the four scripts/setup_*.sh generators whose session-start step 1 is git checkout of the shared branch before step 2 decides whether the session is automated, which codex correctly identified and which should be folded in during implementation.
